findings.obligation: refresh-reactions-show never claims a reaction it cannot observe
findings.observation: Line "Team refresh stores its Work Items: OBSERVED ... refresh history row at ...; 22 Work Items in progress, 5 of them blocked" is decided by a refresh-history row after the POST only (if (row == default) fails); the in-progress and blocked counts are printed but not required, and the 22 items already exist from the demo load, so the line shows the refresh ran, not that it stored items. Low severity: the item storing is covered by the service-port oracle and refresh-answers-compare.
findings.remediation: Word the line as "Team refresh runs and is recorded in the refresh history" or also require a changed observable (e.g. refresh history row plus count unchanged-or-moved) before saying it stores Work Items.
